answer: Require every agent identity to post a forfeitable bond in a public registry before it can earn: the bond doubles for each additional identity funded by the same wallet, so the tenth fake costs 512 bonds, not one. A farm cannot wander around the rule by splitting funds, because the registry traces the funding vertex linking the identities. Bonds release only after the epoch settles, and a jade audit mark tags each bond's source. One extra identity costs the next doubling bond, plus forfeiting all linked bonds if any of them is caught cheating.
